MORE:
Dear Sir / Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Re-quirements) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI LODR Regulations"), we hereby inform you that the 240th Meeting of the Board of Directors of Super Crop Safe Limited was held today, Saturday, November 07, 2026, at the Registered Office of the Company, which commenced at 01:00 P.M. and concluded at 02:15 P.M.
The Board of Directors, inter alia, considered and approved the following business items:
1. Un-Audited Financial Results for Q2 / Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026
2. Trading Window Closure Update
